description: Support for plotting and VTK-ready mesh data extraction.

functions.name: vtk_mesh
functions.description: Create VTK-ready mesh topology data for PyVista visualization. Accepts a Mesh or FunctionSpace.

params.name: msh_or_V
params.description: Mesh or function space to extract VTK data from.

params.name: dim
params.description: Topological dimension of entities to extract (default: mesh dim).

functions.returns_description: (topology, cell_types, geometry) for use with pyvista.UnstructuredGrid.
functions.usage_example: import pyvista; topology, cell_types, geometry = dolfinx.plot.vtk_mesh(mesh); grid = pyvista.UnstructuredGrid(topology, cell_types, geometry)
